notes.title: Dev Log – Preparing for Demo Day
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593586/25b68337fcfa659ddfd0e3168a5b21008d1435d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Next week, we’ll be showcasing [i]No One Leaves the Field[/i] at [b]Demo Day[/b], a local [b]IGDA San Diego event[/b] bringing together game developers to share their projects and gather feedback. It’ll be the first time the game is played live outside our studio, and we can’t wait to see how people react to the shadows, whispers, and secrets we’ve been building.[/p][h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p][b]End-to-End Demo:[/b] The game is now playable straight through, giving us a true sense of pacing, tension, and flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QA Passes:[/b] We’ve been hunting down bugs and smoothing rough edges, making sure nothing pulls players out of the experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanding Lore:[/b] New notes and pages have been scattered across the farm. Some of these are [b]direct excerpts from the [i]Book of Halwena[/i][/b], deepening the curse that binds the land. Each discovery adds another layer to the family’s story — and to the Harvest Mother’s grasp.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Triggers:[/b] Whispers drift through the wheat. A rustle, a creak, a hushed word — subtle touches that make the field feel alive and watching.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Bell Puzzle:[/b] This is the piece we’re especially proud of. Right now it’s just a [b]prototype[/b], but already it adds tension to the farmhouse. Players must ring the bells in the correct sequence to progress. The final demo will make this puzzle even more complex, tying it more tightly into the lore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save System:[/b] A new feature allows you to continue where you left off or start over fresh — essential for testing and for replaying the nightmare.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593586/4e8e77e1ed5c06f7b3143e1558771dae1b2667d1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Looking Ahead[/h3][p align="start"]Demo Day will be our first big chance to [b]gather feedback from live playtesting[/b]. We’re looking to learn:[/p][list][*][p]Do players uncover the lore pages naturally, or should we guide them more?[/p][/*][*][p]Does the bell puzzle feel tense and rewarding?[/p][/*][*][p]Are the whispers and sounds in the wheat subtle enough to unsettle without overwhelming?[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593586/4e9d13e17c87e4cc1931cc6bd39f4e291ab71cf2.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]This feedback will be invaluable as we polish the experience for the public demo release on Steam and itch.io.[/p][p align="start"]We’re proud of where the field is now, but this is just the beginning. Each note found, each bell rung, and each whisper in the wheat brings us closer to the final curse.[/p][p align="start"]The Scarecrow waits. And soon, new voices will enter the field.[/p]

notes.title: 🌾 Dev Log – [Insert Date]: Closing the Loop
notes.content:
[p]They say the field keeps what it takes. The stalks bend and whisper, the shadows lean closer, and every path leads deeper inside. For the first time, our journey through the field can be walked from beginning to end — a tale with a beginning, a middle, and a closing scene that waits like an old, patient curse.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🕯️ [b]What Has Changed[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]The Tools of Travelers[/b] – At last, those who enter the field may shape their path. Brightness for the watchful eye, sound for the trembling ear, and controls for the steady hand. The [b]settings system[/b] is alive, letting each soul choose how they endure the curse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The First Steps Restored[/b] – The broken thread at the start of the tale has been mended. The [b]opening cutscene[/b] now plays true, whispering the first warnings of what’s to come.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shadows in the Corners[/b] – Not all who wander are kind. New, spectral [b]NPCs[/b] now drift across the farm, reminding players that they are never alone, even when the wind stills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The House Unbarred[/b] – When the right deeds are done, the farmhouse finally opens its doors. But inside waits dust, memory, and the echo of voices long gone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Circle Complete[/b] – For the first time, the [b]entire demo loop[/b] is closed. A player may begin at the edge of the field and walk their way to the final scene — a story that ends as the scarecrow intended.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌾 [b]What Comes Next[/b][/h3][p]The curse is woven, but the field still asks for polish:[/p][list][*][p]More [b]whispers and sounds[/b], to haunt the ears and unsettle the heart.[/p][/*][*][p]More [b]shifting lights and signs[/b], to beckon the lost onward.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Playtesting[/b], where brave wanderers will walk the path and tell us where it falters.[/p][/*][*][p]And soon, the ability to enter the wheat with a [b]gamepad in hand[/b], for those who wish to hold their fear a little tighter.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🎮 [b]Wishlist [i]No One Leaves the Field[/i] on Steam:[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652690/No_One_Leaves_the_Field/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]The scarecrow waits by the well.
The Harvest Mother watches from the dark.
The field is ready for you.[/p][p]#JoinTheSaga[/p]

notes.title: Dev Log – June 1, 2025: Footsteps and Filling Out the Field
notes.content:
✅ What’s New:
Footstep Audio
You’ll now hear your own footsteps as you move through the wheat—just enough to remind you you’re not alone.

Player Controller Upgrade
We migrated to Unity’s Player Controller system to improve movement feel and give us more flexibility down the line.

Landmark Additions
The dried well and work shed have been added to the world and will play key roles in exploration and narrative.

Environmental Details
We’ve begun scattering random grass, small trees, and bushes throughout the field to make each run feel more alive.

🔜 Coming Up:
Completing the inventory system

UI for reading journals and letters

Building out level states and mapping progression

Adding music cues and more ambient sound triggers

🗒️ From the Studio
While we’re not participating in this June’s Steam Next Fest, we’re cheering for all the amazing indie games being showcased. We’ll continue to build toward our own demo launch later this summer.

🎮 Wishlist No One Leaves the Field on Steam

Thanks for walking with us through the wheat.
#JoinTheSaga

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Log – May 25, 2025: Wheat Patrol and Setbacks
notes.content:
Not everything went as planned this week—but the field is louder, the scarecrow is walking, and bugs were squashed.

✅ What’s New:
Scarecrow Patrol AI
The scarecrow now patrols the wheat field. If you're inside the wheat and he senses you, he’ll reset your progress. We’ve added a Cinemachine camera trigger to make those moments hit harder.
Wheat Rustle Audio
The field now reacts to you. As you walk through the wheat, it rustles softly—adding tension to every step.
Singleton Bug Fix
We ran into a nasty singleton mismatch issue that only appeared in builds (not the editor). It took time to isolate, but it’s been fixed.
🛠️ In Progress:
GUI updates for the main menu and pause menu
Steam wishlist and feedback links now integrated into the UI (demo prep underway)
🔜 Coming Up:
📖 Finish the letter/journal reader
🏚️ Add key landmarks like the dried well and toolshed
🔄 Begin building level states and mapping out story progression points
🗒️ Notes from the Studio
This week had its share of setbacks—but meaningful systems are taking shape. The field is no longer quiet. The scarecrow is no longer idle.

🎮 Wishlist No One Leaves the Field on Steam
💬 [Feedback form will be live with the demo]
Thank you for following along. We’re getting closer.

#JoinTheSaga
#DevLog #HorrorGames #NoOneLeavesTheField #IndieDev

notes.title: Dev Log – May 18, 2025: Tasks, Sounds, and Global Access
notes.content:
✅ What’s New This Week:
Pause Menu Upgrade
We’ve updated the layout and added spaces for your inventory and current task, so you always know what you’re carrying—and what you’re supposed to be doing.
Task Management System
We implemented a full system to track which tasks the player has received and which ones are complete. It’s the spine of how the game will progress.
Inspector Fine-Tuning
You can now zoom in on specific objects—whether it's a letter, a tool, or something better left alone.
Sound Manager Integration
Ambient audio is live! The field now rustles, hums, and whispers the way it should. It’s subtle, but it changes everything.
🌍 Localization Progress
We’ve localized the Steam page into the following languages:

🇲🇽 Latin American Spanish
🇧🇷 Portuguese
🇷🇺 Russian
🇯🇵 Japanese
These are the first wave of supported languages we plan to offer at launch. If your region is on the list—welcome! If not, we’re listening.

🎮 Wishlist No One Leaves the Field on Steam
🛠️ Coming Next:
Finalizing the inventory manager
Adding more environmental sounds and music cues
Implementing the UI for reading letters and journals
The field is getting louder, deeper, and stranger.

Thanks for joining the journey.

#JoinTheSaga
#DevLog #NoOneLeavesTheField #HorrorGames #IndieDev

notes.title: 🧠 Dev Log – May 11, 2025: Loading In and Speaking Up
notes.content:
Happy Mother’s Day to all the moms, mother-figures, and supportive souls out there—we hope you're getting a moment to rest or make something spooky today. 💐

This week in No One Leaves the Field, we hit a big internal milestone: our first playable build is now up and running!

✅ What’s New This Week:
Loading Screen: We now transition smoothly between scenes, keeping immersion intact.
Localization System: The game is now structured to support multiple languages (and possibly cursed scripts).
Item Interaction: You can now interact with the world—starting with doors. More object types to come.
Dialogue Box: The player has a voice now (text-only), through a clean, stylized dialogue system.
🔜 Coming Up Next:
Fine-tuning the interaction system
Expanding interaction to support new object types
Starting to place major world landmarks like:
– 🕳️ The dried well
– 🚽 The outhouse
🎮 Wishlist Now:
If you haven’t already, you can wishlist the game here and follow for future updates:

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652690/No_One_Leaves_the_Field/

The field is getting louder. Thanks for walking with us.
